scope: Portable native settings with verified writes and fallback
On-device OCR with editable text and no image upload
Faithful/natural prompt; names and numbers preserved by instruction
Bounded text sections with completion validation and manual retry
Explicit save, literal history search and offline cache reuse
Session-only key by default; explicit readable TXT opt-in
limits: Native transport/I/O failures may stop the system action directly
OCR and translation quality require device/provider testing
No app-level password encryption or Keychain companion
No automatic import of the old unstructured TXT history
iCloud multi-device settings follow file-sync semantics
